data.heading: Return as often

image.alt: A laptop, phone, rose notebook and coffee on a bright desk.

steps.title: Notice what's changing
steps.body: Energy, sleep, weight or mood feel different, and you want to understand why.

steps.title: Explore your options
steps.body: Read, take the Health Map, or look at care and the shop. None of them requires the others.

steps.title: Choose what fits
steps.body: Care, shop, Health Map or membership, based on what you need right now.

steps.title: Return as your needs change
steps.body: Come back when something shifts. Your next step can change with you.

data.heading: Want ongoing support?
data.sub: Membership adds personalized learning and quarterly check-ins for $129 per month. Clinical visits, labs, medications and products are separate unless a specific offer says otherwise.

data.body: The BCH Health Map is educational. Licensed providers use a separate clinical intake for medical decisions.
